description: Use when you need the current UTC time from a server clock, the local time, UTC offset and DST flag in up to 10 IANA time zones (tz=Europe/Berlin,Asia/Tokyo). Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /time, $0.001 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

at.description: time to convert: ISO 8601 (2026-10-05T09:00, with or without offset) or unix seconds/milliseconds; default now

to.description: IANA zone(s) to convert at= into, comma-separated, up to 10

tz.description: IANA zone(s), comma-separated, up to 10 (e.g. Europe/Berlin,Asia/Tokyo). With at= and no offset in it, the first zone is the zone of that wall time

name: time
title: Time
